## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- PT-141 is DESIRE support (brain-based, non-hormonal, on-demand). No "ED", "erectile", "performance", "Viagra", "instant",
  "ignite", no timing promises ("tonight", "in minutes"), no guarantees. Mechanism first; "supports", never "builds"/"boosts".
- **No beds or bedroom scenes**, no lingerie, no body shots, no couples in bed, no before/after. A person is clothed, candid,
  30–55, shoulder-up or waist-up, in a daytime setting (kitchen, hallway, terrace, café, car, bathroom counter, garden).
- Form: copy may say "nasal spray" / "sublingual tablet" / "easy sublingual delivery"; never a strength, dose or count.
  Never show the tablet with the spray. No needles, syringes or vials; the spray is held, never sprayed on camera.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically studied" for the product.
- Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793912918-b19b; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 59%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: Discount to feature, by product). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 59%". **All bible CTAs:** "Explore PT-141" · "Save Up to 59%" · "Start Desire Support" · "PT-141 for $2.00/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "PT-141 for $2.00/day".
- **Variant maximums (reference only, never shown as a lower %):** nasal spray 23%, sublingual 59%.
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** Supports Brain-Based Desire · Promotes On-Demand Desire · Non-Hormonal Desire Support · Encourages Intimate Readiness · Supports Central Desire Pathways.
- **More approved benefits:** Desire Support on Your Schedule · Supports Mind-Body Responsiveness · Desire Starts in the Brain · Helps Awaken Desire · Supports Sexual Motivation.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** No beds or bedroom scenes. · Never use “arousal” or any form of it (“aroused,” “arousing”). · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now · Gentle on the Vascular System · Helps Wake Up the Want · Sublingual or Nasal Spray Desire Support · Support Your Spark · Find Your Plan.
- **Disclaimer:** verbatim in `product.json` (= the bible's); the finisher lays it. Exact strings for pasting: `python3 core/scripts/product_copy.py <id>`.
